semantic_roundtrip.remaining_semantic_delta: Source Euclidean squared distances specialize an explicitly more general NormedAddCommGroup identity. The underlying real-sequence lemma allows signed/zero potentials and weights, no monotonicity and no terminal bound. The distance theorem retains T>0 and eta_t>0 at every played index. Lean index0 is source round1, x(T) is source x_(T+1), eta(T-1) is source eta_T. No loss regularity, feedback legality, feasible-set diameter or algorithm recursion is asserted by this algebraic equality. No missing-half source correction is proposed.
